# Komoot

> Komoot is an outdoor route planner and discovery platform for hiking, cycling, running, and walking with AI-powered route recommendations, topographic maps, and voice navigation.

Komoot provides location-based outdoor activity discovery and route planning across multiple sports including mountain biking, road cycling, hiking, and trail running. The platform features curated collections of famous long-distance trails and individual route guides with difficulty ratings, elevation data, and points of interest.

## Key Topics

- Route Planning
- Outdoor Navigation
- Hiking Trails
- Cycling Routes
- Trail Discovery
- Topographic Maps
- Voice Navigation
- Mountain Biking
- Long-Distance Hiking
- Route Collections
- Difficulty Ratings
- GPX Format
- Location-Based Discovery
- Trail Guides
- Outdoor Activities

## Core Products

- [Route Planner](https://www.komoot.com/plan): Main route planner product for cycling, hiking, walking, MTB and running with AI-powered recommendations
- [Discover](https://www.komoot.com/discover): Main discovery hub for hiking, biking, and outdoor activities worldwide with location-based route suggestions
- [Discover Near You](https://www.komoot.com/discover/start_from_current_location/tours): Location-based route discovery for MTB, hiking, cycling with must-see spots and local recommendations
- [Features](https://www.komoot.com/features): Overview of Komoot features including voice navigation, topographic maps, and trail recommendations

## Featured Trail Collections

- [John Muir Trail](https://www.komoot.com/collection/291/john-muir-trail-along-the-legendary-trail-through-the-magical-sierra-nevada): 22-stage John Muir Trail guide through Yosemite and Sierra Nevada with detailed hiking stages
- [North Coast 500](https://www.komoot.com/collection/1159215/north-coast-500-escape-to-the-highlands): 500-mile Scottish Highlands road cycling route through coastal scenery
- [GR20 Trail](https://www.komoot.com/collection/276/gr20-europe-s-toughest-long-distance-hiking-trail-through-corsica): 15-stage GR20 trail guide through Corsica's challenging alpine terrain
- [Kerry Way](https://www.komoot.com/collection/683/the-kerry-way-in-9-stages-over-ireland-s-mountains): 9-stage Kerry Way guide around Iveragh Peninsula in Ireland

## Bay Area Hiking Routes

- [Mission Peak and Peak Meadow Loop](https://www.komoot.com/smarttour/e2813435148/mission-peak-and-peak-meadow-loop-from-ohlone-college): Hard Bay Area hike from Ohlone College with elevation gain challenge
- [Hamms Gulch to Spring Ridge Loop](https://www.komoot.com/smarttour/e2813329668/hamms-gulch-to-spring-ridge-loop): Moderate hike in San Mateo County, California with scenic ridge views
- [Stephen E. Abbors, Coyote, and High Meadow Loop](https://www.komoot.com/smarttour/e2813335289/stephen-e-abbors-coyote-and-high-meadow-loop): Moderate 8-mile Bay Area hike with panoramic views in California
- [Stephen E. Abbors, Wildcat, and Coyote Trail Loop](https://www.komoot.com/smarttour/e2813327743/stephen-e-abbors-wildcat-and-coyote-trail-loop): Easy Cupertino Bay Area hike loop in open space preserve
- [Wildcat Loop Trail](https://www.komoot.com/smarttour/e2813382858/wildcat-loop-trail): Moderate 6-mile loop in Santa Clara County with bay views
- [Penitencia Creek and North Rim Loop](https://www.komoot.com/smarttour/e2813387317/penitencia-creek-and-north-rim-loop): Moderate creek hike in Alum Rock Park, San Jose area day hike
- [Adobe Creek Loop Trail](https://www.komoot.com/smarttour/e2813363607/adobe-creek-loop-trail): Moderate Palo Alto loop trail with birdwatching in Baylands preserve
- [Rogue Valley, Upper Rogue Valley, and High Meadow Loop](https://www.komoot.com/smarttour/e2813375802/rogue-valley-upper-rogue-valley-and-high-meadow-loop-trail): Moderate Santa Clara County loop at Rancho San Antonio
- [Saratoga Gap and Ridge Trail Loop](https://www.komoot.com/smarttour/e2813394970/saratoga-gap-and-ridge-trail-loop): Hard 7-mile Castle Rock State Park waterfall hike in Santa Cruz
